title: VCR inspiration item
description: One item in the workspace inspiration library, inspiration/items/<id>.json (ADR 0011). The file it describes is copied to the git-ignored inspiration/files/<id>/. What a person stated (note, aspects, use, rights, source), what a tool measured (facts) and what a model judged (observations) stay in separate fields (ADR 0012): no agent writes the stated fields, and observations never stand in for a note.

id.description: The file name without .json. A slug of the source file name plus the first six hex of its sha256; a colour set uses a slug of its title

note.description: Stated: what the user likes in this item, in their words. Only a person writes it

aspects.description: Stated: what to take from the item

use.description: Stated. An inspiration item informs a treatment and never appears in output; only an asset with rights evidence may

rights.description: Stated. Required when use is asset; "unknown" is recorded honestly and fails validation on an asset

evidence.description: Where permission comes from: a licence name and locator, a purchase record, or own work

source.description: Stated. Recorded as text; nothing is fetched

locator.description: URL or other address the item came from

file.description: The copied file at inspiration/files/<id>/<name>. Absent for a colour set

colours.description: kind colours only: the values as the user gave them

facts.description: Measured from the file at intake. Stored because the file is fixed by its hash and the tool may be absent later (ADR 0012)

licence.description: The font's own licence string, as embedded. Not rights evidence

observations.description: Judged: what a model saw. Appended only through `vcr inspiration observe`

inferred.description: A principle that could transfer, kept apart from the description (VREF-LAYERS-SEPARATED)

span.description: The inspected time span a claim about a video rests on, as t=<start>,<end> in seconds (VREF-TEMPORAL-SPAN)

allOf.description: A colour set has values and no file; every other kind has a file and no values
Facts name the tool that measured them
